title: Dual scheme Windows Auth + cookies/client auth
meaning: One application can support Windows Authentication for employees and another scheme, often cookies or tokens, for non-domain clients.
Multiple schemes require explicit defaults, policies, or per-endpoint scheme selection.
Windows Auth is not the same as a normal login page; it is challenge/response at the HTTP/server layer.
Cookie auth is app-issued and normally follows a login flow; Windows Auth is identity delegated from OS/domain infrastructure.
Endpoints must clearly state which scheme/policy they require to avoid accidental fallback or wrong challenge behavior.
boundary_notes: R01/R02 cover the core model/basic Negotiate setup.
R04 covers company deployment, SPN and troubleshooting.
